notes: Box lets a user pay for an off-chain-quoted swarm order in imdUSD. Constructor (imdUsd, treasury, float_, signer): imdUSD v1 (plain 18-decimal ERC-20, no permit), the imdUSD Treasury, the FLOAT operator wallet that pays the swarm, and the SIGNER EOA that signs settlements. All four are static addresses from the brief; the constructor only rejects zero addresses and makes no external call. pay() sends the first request's cost to FLOAT and a buffer to TREASURY and holds the rest as escrow, keyed by keccak256(payer, orderId). Escrow leaves only through settle/settleMany (an EIP-712 Settlement signed by SIGNER that splits exactly that order's escrow among TREASURY, FLOAT and the payer; anyone may execute) or the payer's reclaim() from 60 days after payment. settleMany skips orders that are already closed. Box has no owner, admin, pause, setter or upgrade path, so $owner is not used.
